title: Suspek rempuh kenderaan PGA direman empat hari
summary: Pasir Mas: Lelaki yang merempuh kenderaan Pasukan Gerakan Am (PGA) sehingga menyebabkan seorang anggota polis patah tangan ketika cuba melarikan diri semalam, direman selama empat hari.

title_en: Suspect hit PGA vehicle, detained for four days
summary_en: Pasir Mas: A man who hit a PGA vehicle and broke the arm of a police officer while trying to escape yesterday, was detained for four days.
